snippet.title: KAWAGOE, JAPAN 🇯🇵 | Exploring Japan’s Little Edo | 4K Walking Tour
snippet.description:
Explore Kawagoe, Japan’s charming “Little Edo,” in this immersive 4K walking tour. 🇯🇵

Located just outside Tokyo, Kawagoe is famous for its beautifully preserved Edo-period atmosphere, traditional kurazukuri warehouse-style buildings, and historic shopping streets.

Walk through the heart of Kawagoe’s Old Town, discover traditional Japanese architecture, local shops, and experience the lively yet nostalgic atmosphere of this beautiful historic town.

No talking. No music added. Just the natural sounds of Japan.

📍 Kawagoe, Saitama, Japan

🎥 Filmed in 4K for an immersive walking experience.

snippet.title: Hidden Soba Restaurant in Little Edo, Kawagoe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan 🇯🇵🗾💕
snippet.description:
Hidden Soba Restaurant in Little Edo, Kawagoe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan 🗾💕

While avoiding the crowds in Saitama prefecture’s Little Edo (a quick day trip from Tokyo!), I stumbled upon this restaurant sandwiched in the residential area of Kawagoe. 🇯🇵

The restaurant looks amazing! The garden is not as verdant as what a traditional Japanese garden should be, it was rough, simple, and charming. The interior is a typical Japanese home. It’s very cosy. You might enjoy the natural light from the long engawa. Beautiful details throughout, the different corners and sliding doors, accents of samurai swords, Japanese paintings, and ceramics. 🍤

The food is simple and comforting. It’s like being invited in someone’s home. 😊👍

Sobadokoro Aikawa
そば処 會川
📍6-3 Kitamachi, Kawagoe, Saitama 350-0061, Japan
⌚️open 11AM-4PM everyday

snippet.title: Kawagoe Day Trip from Tokyo // AWESOME Things to do in Japan!
snippet.description:
Kawagoe (川越) is located about 30 minutes by train on Tobu Railway from central Tokyo and is a wonderful day trip destination! 

Here is my exact  Kawagoe Day Trip from Tokyo Itinerary:

Take the Tobu Express train from Ikebukuro Station(Tojo Line Express to Ogawamachi)

Kitain Temple

One of the most important temples in the Greater Tokyo area, Kitain Temple, is one of Kawagoe's main attractions! It is famous for its main hall, which was part of the original Edo Castle, and the statues of 540 Rakan, disciples of the Buddha. It is also known informally as the Kawagoe Daishi. I visited during the sakura season and enjoyed the spring decorations and cherry blossoms!

Lunch at Kappo Kawashima (Traditional Japanese Cuisine). The food is delicious and you dine in a private room! You can make a reservation here: https://jpneazy.com/restaurant/restinfo.html?id=g782100

Hikawa Shrine 

The Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine is said to be approximately 1500 years old and is where five deities are enshrined: Susanoo no Mikoto, Kushinadahime no Mikoto, Ashinazuchi no Mikoto, Tenazuchi no Mikoto, and Oonamuchi no Mikoto.

With two sets of deities that are regarded as married couples, the shrine has been historically worshiped for "matrimonial happiness", "happiness in the family" and the "deity of matchmaking". 

Kashiya Yokocho Lane (Traditional Style Japanese Candy Lane)

Ichibangai Historical Shopping Street

Its main street, lined with Kurazukuri (clay-walled warehouse-styled) buildings, retains an ambiance reminiscent of an old town from the Edo Period (1603-1867). Visiting feels like stepping back in time to imagine the streets from past centuries. Because of this, Kawagoe became known as "Little Edo".

Roman Sabo Umon Café (Japanese Tea & dessert). I always recommend trying the desserts that are in season and special to the time of year you are there.

Take Tobu Express train from Kawagoe Station (Tojo Line Express to Ikebukuro)

Tobu has an amazing discount pass that includes a roundtrip ticket and special discounts and freebies at various restaurants and retailers.

Where to purchase the pass:
Tobu Tourist Information Center IKEBUKURO
Tobu Tojo Line counter in Ikebukuro Station
TOBU TOP TOURS Ikebukuro Station branch

More info here: http://www.tobu.co.jp/foreign/en/pass/kawagoe.html

If you are traveling to Tokyo, I sincerely suggest you take a day trip to Kawagoe. If you visit during the fall or spring, you are super lucky!

Also watch Top Things to do in Tokyo with Kids: Tokyo Skytree, Sumida Aquarium, Solamachi, and Sensoji Temple: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2H8VJvk9dso

Kawagoe is super easy to navigate, even with kids! We took taxis and found them easy to find and reasonably priced.

localized.description:
Kawagoe (川越) is located about 30 minutes by train on Tobu Railway from central Tokyo and is a wonderful day trip destination! 

Here is my exact  Kawagoe Day Trip from Tokyo Itinerary:

Take the Tobu Express train from Ikebukuro Station(Tojo Line Express to Ogawamachi)

Kitain Temple

One of the most important temples in the Greater Tokyo area, Kitain Temple, is one of Kawagoe's main attractions! It is famous for its main hall, which was part of the original Edo Castle, and the statues of 540 Rakan, disciples of the Buddha. It is also known informally as the Kawagoe Daishi. I visited during the sakura season and enjoyed the spring decorations and cherry blossoms!

Lunch at Kappo Kawashima (Traditional Japanese Cuisine). The food is delicious and you dine in a private room! You can make a reservation here: https://jpneazy.com/restaurant/restinfo.html?id=g782100

Hikawa Shrine 

The Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine is said to be approximately 1500 years old and is where five deities are enshrined: Susanoo no Mikoto, Kushinadahime no Mikoto, Ashinazuchi no Mikoto, Tenazuchi no Mikoto, and Oonamuchi no Mikoto.

With two sets of deities that are regarded as married couples, the shrine has been historically worshiped for "matrimonial happiness", "happiness in the family" and the "deity of matchmaking". 

Kashiya Yokocho Lane (Traditional Style Japanese Candy Lane)

Ichibangai Historical Shopping Street

Its main street, lined with Kurazukuri (clay-walled warehouse-styled) buildings, retains an ambiance reminiscent of an old town from the Edo Period (1603-1867). Visiting feels like stepping back in time to imagine the streets from past centuries. Because of this, Kawagoe became known as "Little Edo".

Roman Sabo Umon Café (Japanese Tea & dessert). I always recommend trying the desserts that are in season and special to the time of year you are there.

Take Tobu Express train from Kawagoe Station (Tojo Line Express to Ikebukuro)

Tobu has an amazing discount pass that includes a roundtrip ticket and special discounts and freebies at various restaurants and retailers.

Where to purchase the pass:
Tobu Tourist Information Center IKEBUKURO
Tobu Tojo Line counter in Ikebukuro Station
TOBU TOP TOURS Ikebukuro Station branch

More info here: http://www.tobu.co.jp/foreign/en/pass/kawagoe.html

If you are traveling to Tokyo, I sincerely suggest you take a day trip to Kawagoe. If you visit during the fall or spring, you are super lucky!

Also watch Top Things to do in Tokyo with Kids: Tokyo Skytree, Sumida Aquarium, Solamachi, and Sensoji Temple: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2H8VJvk9dso

Kawagoe is super easy to navigate, even with kids! We took taxis and found them easy to find and reasonably priced.

snippet.title: 👘 [4K HDR] Discover Kawagoe, The Little Edo (Koedo) | Experience Old Japan 🇯🇵
snippet.description:
Please 👍 to support our work and follow us for more virtual tours in Japan! 🇯🇵

If you are in Tokyo and you want to explore a traditional city not too far (30 minutes away), Kawagoe is the best option! It's actually the very first place I visited when I arrived in Japan so it has a very special place in my heart! ❤️

Kawagoe nickname is Ko-Edo, which basically means "The Little Edo". Edo is the old name of Tokyo and Kawagoe is often called Ko-Edo because it looks like Tokyo city during the Edo period.

Visiting Kawagoe is like traveling through time! ⌛

During this video, we will visit beautiful temples and shrines first to finally arrive at the traditional Kanetsuki street with its gorgeous Bell Tower (Toki no Kane). You will see here a lot of Japanese girls wearing traditional kimono. The Starbucks of this street is also really nice with a Japanese zen garden inside it! We will finish our tour in Kashiya Yokocho, the candy alley where you can buy a lot of delicious sweet street food!

More travel tips about Kawagoe here: https://asianwanderlust.com/en/what-to-do-in-kawagoe-japan/

snippet.title: 埼玉 川越の夜散歩 前編【小江戸のイメージを裏切る？駅前のナイトライフエリア】
snippet.description:
2026年8月29日の19時20分頃から約2時間、埼玉県の川越駅周辺をのんびりと散歩しました。今回はその【前半】の動画です。

「小江戸」として全国的に有名な川越ですが、駅周辺は多くの人々が行き交う埼玉県有数の賑やかな商業エリアとなっています。前半の動画では、川越駅の西口・東口のペデストリアンデッキをスタートし、活気あふれる巨大商店街「クレアモール」を歩いて本川越駅・川越市駅周辺へと向かいました。

観光地の顔とはひと味違う、地元の人々の熱気と日常の賑わいに満ちた川越のナイトライフをお楽しみいただけます。後半の動画では歴史ある「蔵造りの街並み」エリアを訪れますので、ぜひ併せてご覧ください！

snippet.title: 【2026最新版】後編！百万灯夏まつりリポート 実際の提灯の数は何個あるのか歩いて全部調べた結果 #百万灯夏まつり #祭り #川越
snippet.description:
百万灯夏まつりとは、主に埼玉県川越市で毎年7月下旬に開催される
数多くの色鮮やかな提灯が街を彩る歴史ある夏の市民祭りです。

江戸時代に亡くなった藩主をしのんで切子灯籠を掲げたことが始まりとされています。
起源と歴史1850年（嘉永3年）に、川越藩主・松平大和守斉典の遺徳をしのんで
灯籠を掲げたことが由来です。

一時中断されましたが、昭和35年に復活し、
昭和57年に現在の「川越百万灯夏まつり」という名称になりました。

祭りの特徴開催日は例年7月最後の土曜日とその翌日の日曜日です。
蔵造りの町並みや本川越駅周辺などの通りが歩行者天国になります。
無数の提灯に明かりが灯り、幻想的な雰囲気に包まれます。

時代行列やお囃子、地元グルメの食べ歩きなどが楽しめます！

提灯と灯篭の主な違いは、使う場所、素材や構造、持ち運びやすさです。
提灯は竹と紙でできており軽く持ち運びできますが、
灯篭は石や金属などでできており屋外に固定して置きます。

▼提灯の特徴
作り：竹の骨組みに紙を貼り、折りたためる。
使い方：手で持って歩いたり、軒先や室内に吊るしたりして使う。
役割：移動式の明かりや、お盆の目印、お店の看板など。

▼灯篭の特徴
作り：石、木、金属などで頑丈に作られた据え置き型の照明。
使い方：神社仏閣や庭に固定して置く。
役割：今の街灯や、景色を引き立てる飾りの役割を持つ

snippet.title: One last ride on JR to Kawagoe
snippet.description:
Japan's final chapter 

Day 7 we caught the Shinkansen back from Okayama to Tokyo, checked into Blossom Shinjuku, and ended the night with a bowl of ramen that had absolutely no right to be that good at that hour.

Day 8 — one JR pass day left. We weren't wasting it. Jumped on the  Shinkansen to Kawagoe, aka Little Edo. Old bell towers, retro streets,  buses that look like they belong in a Studio Ghibli film. Then dinner  at Momo Paradise — A4 wagyu shabu shabu buffet. We didn't hold back.

Day 9, we went home. But not before unagi.

Caught blue hour on the flight back. Japan didn't let us leave without 
one last beautiful moment.

See you in the next adventure 🙏

snippet.title: Tour Charming Shops in Historical Kawagoe
snippet.description:
Archived video from the Greater Tokyo Virtual Tour on Saturday, November 13th, 2021.
We would love to hear your feedback!
https://forms.gle/zJcWT5Q6LfmpMfGm7
-------------------------------------------------------------------
If you’re a Tokyo fan, you have probably already visited Kawagoe at least once. The historical part of the city is famous for its traditional buildings that have been renovated into stylish shops and restaurants.

Kan-san, the local guide greets you at the Time Bell Tower, a Kawagoe landmark, then takes you on a stroll along back alleys lined with shops selling local treats. You’ll learn where to rent a beautiful yukata (summer kimono), where to find the best sweet potato sweets--a delicious local specialty, and visit a candy shop. The tour includes video footage of the wind chime festival held each summer at Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine!

She also introduces the convenient Tobu Pass, a ticket that includes a roundtrip to Kawagoe from Tokyo, as well as discounts at partner shops. You’ll definitely want to use this pass when visiting Kawagoe!

* A simple mosaic has been applied to the parts of the video that show public people.
* Since the video was shot live, there are some audio and video problems due to the internet environment.

snippet.title: 埼玉県川越市大正浪漫夢通りライブカメラ
snippet.description:
川越市は、埼玉県の北西部に位置し、歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する、まさに唯一無二の景観が広がる都市です。

この地域の景色は、江戸時代の町並みと現代の都市機能、豊かな自然環境が織りなす、他では見られない特別な風景を生み出しています。

 

四季の変化が鮮明に表現される川越の景色は、まさに日本の歴史と自然の芸術作品と言えるでしょう

。春には、川越城址公園の桜並木が淡いピンクの花を咲かせ、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと見事に調和します。

特に、小江戸と呼ばれる川越の歴史的町並みに咲く桜は、まさに川越にしか存在しない唯一無二の風景です。

 

夏は、伝統的な蔵造りの町並みと近代的な都市景観が融合した景色が広がります。

川越の中心市街地では、歴史的な建造物と現代の建築が共存し、まるで絵はがきのような美しさを醸し出します。

特に夕暮れ時の蔵造りの街並みは、他では見られない独特の魅力を放っています。

 

秋になると、川越市内の寺社や公園が鮮やかな紅葉に染まります。

特に、喜多院や川越城址公園の紅葉は、まるで自然が描いた絵画のようで、歴史的な建造物と紅葉のコントラストは息をのむほどの美しさです。

 

冬は、伝統的な町並みと雪景色が、静寂と美しさを演出します。

蔵造りの町並みに雪が積もる様子は、まさに川越にしか存在しない、唯一無二の景観を作り出します。

 

歴史と伝統、そして現代が見事に融合する川越景観をお楽しみください。

また、システムの不具合や混雑による電波状況の悪化により、配信が一時停止することがあります。
